title: NASA Axes LINK Rescue Mission to Save Swift Space Telescope
summary: But NASA announced that the mission had been canceled earlier this week, due to an "attitude control issue." The spacecraft will instead attempt to conduct "rendezvous and proximity operations" with NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory.
